A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SOCO research work and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G. Content can be matched despite reference relocation, table restructuring, and pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original vision-model and LVLM evaluations, downstream-task measurements, correlation analyses, and supplementary experiments in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains original empirical evaluations and reports additional model comparisons, a fixed-patch control, and revised numerical results.

M1.justification: The taxonomy, annotation procedure, nearest-neighbor matching in Equation 1, and downstream probe designs are retained. SOC-geo, soft-argmax evaluation, and linear probing already appear in v1. The added resolution controls do not establish a change to the proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same 100 SOCO categories, image sources, correspondence tasks, and LVLM query scenarios. MISC210K, SPair-71k, AP-10K, and the downstream-task datasets are unchanged. Revised pair counts and additional model configurations do not introduce new task or population coverage.

E2.justification: Table r5 substantially expands the evaluated comparator set, adding ConvNeXt variants, DeiT3, MiDaS, VGGT-1B, and V-JEPA2-L, alongside additional variants of retained families. These are actual reported comparisons beyond the renaming of existing model rows.

E3.justification: v3 adds a fixed 60×60-patch protocol and explicit DUNE resolution comparisons. Section 4.2 revises the available pair counts from about 62k to 73k SOC pairs and 940k to 1.3M cross-category pairs, while retaining 20k-pair evaluations. Table r10 revises C-RADIOv3's stated architecture from ViT-H/16 to ViT-B/16; this does not establish a rerun.

E4.justification: Appendix A.2 and Table r2 add a control testing whether model rankings depend on using fixed image resolution versus fixed patch count; Table r5 also adds DUNE resolution comparisons. SOC-geo, viewpoint sensitivity, PCK-threshold analyses, and visual-marker ablations already existed in v1.

E5.justification: Both versions retain 95% bootstrap confidence intervals using 10,000 resamples, leave-one-out checks, and the dense-SSL subset analysis. Table r9 preserves the reported confidence intervals. No changed seed, repeated-run, or uncertainty-estimation practice is documented.

E6.justification: Substantial numerical revisions span the main and supplementary results. Table 2 changes SD 2.1 SOC from 44.8 to 49.0 and QWEN-L from 19.4 to 26.0; DINOv2 SOC-geo changes from 60.97 in v1 Table r2 to 71.9 in v3 Table 2. Linear-probe and downstream scores also change. Table 3 newly reports the previously described DINOv2 four-choice baseline at 81.0%, and Table r5 adds many model results. These are reported revisions, without establishing same-setting performance gains.

T1.justification: The correspondence definitions, nearest-neighbor equation, PCK definition, and SOC-geo formulation are retained. Moving the SOC-geo explanation into the main text adds no mathematical definition or derivation. Neither version introduces theoretical proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and headline claims: a taxonomy-driven benchmark, structured and cross-category correspondence weaknesses, LVLM localization-versus-matching differences, and SOC's diagnostic relationship to downstream performance. Additional evidence does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: v3 newly discusses how fixed image resolution favors smaller patches and interprets the fixed-patch experiment as evidence of ranking stability. Section 5.2 removes the earlier no-vision-LLM chance-performance argument. Most mechanism explanations and the substantive limitations in Appendix F remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A.2 newly specifies 500-pixel resolution for linear probing, and Appendix D.2 specifies timestep 250 for SD 2.1. Section 5.1 clarifies resolution adjustments for patch-size divisibility. These improve documentation without establishing when the implementation choices were adopted.

R1.justification: The same 82 cited works are retained, with unchanged substantive positioning against earlier correspondence benchmarks and multimodal evaluations. Reference renumbering, publication updates, author-name corrections, and abbreviated venues are bibliographic edits.

P1.justification: v3 locally expands the evaluation explanations, rewrites the LVLM query-setting description, and repeats the existing SOC-geo explanation in the main text. References move before the supplement, and running headers and acknowledgments change. The overall narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 and the Table 3 query-setting illustration are redesigned, and Figure 2's SOC label is corrected. Table 2 replaces the average column with SOC-geo; Table r2 reorganizes its protocol columns. Table r5 expands and standardizes labels, while Table r6 compresses the category results into two side-by-side blocks.

improvement.justification: The new fixed-patch control addresses a comparison-fairness concern, while broader model comparisons and the explicit DINOv2 four-choice result strengthen support for existing conclusions. Added implementation details also improve reproducibility. The gain is limited by unexplained score revisions and incomplete numerical reconciliation: v3 reports SD 2.1 SOC as 49.0 in Table 2 but 48.8 under pair averaging in Table r3.
